DELETE FROM recovery_orders WHERE tenant='t4'; INSERT INTO recovery_orders VALUES('t4','o82','r82',25);
SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM recovery_orders r ORDER BY order_id
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_archiver WHERE failed_count=0 AND archived_count>=3

CREATE TABLE recovered_later(LIKE recovery_orders INCLUDING ALL); INSERT INTO recovered_later VALUES('t4','o82','r82',25); SELECT l.* FROM recovered_later l JOIN recovery_orders r USING(tenant,request_id) WHERE (l.order_id,l.price) IS DISTINCT FROM (r.order_id,r.price); INSERT INTO recovery_orders SELECT * FROM recovered_later ON CONFLICT(tenant,request_id) DO NOTHING; SELECT * FROM recovery_orders ORDER BY order_id;
